tweaks.name: Start menu recommendations configuration

Layers: (1) Start_TrackDocs=0 and Start_TrackProgs=0 (DWord) under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced - the Start_Track* family this category owns (Start_TrackDocs = 'recently opened items in Start, Jump Lists and File Explorer'; Start_TrackProgs = 'most used apps'); both values verified present read-only on build 26300.9974. (2) HideRecommendedSection=1 (DWord) under HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer - the documented 'Remove Recommended section from Start Menu' policy (StartMenu.admx, User and Device, applicable Windows 11 22H2+; Policy CSP Start page verified 2026-11-23). Build detection is read-only (CurrentBuildNumber, with an environment fallback); every layer is journaled, idempotent, and safe-stops on verification failure by restoring the exact original. Edition honesty: both documented policy rows list Pro/Enterprise/Education/IoT Enterprise; on Home the policy layers may be documentation-limited - the function reports unverified policy layers and restores them, while the Start_Track* per-user values still apply. Evidence E0 as the catalogue assigns (Start_Track* are community-known); the two policy layers are documented (E1) and labeled as such rather than inflating the entry's evidence level. Boundary note (coordinator, 2026-11-23): NoInstrumentation belongs to NX13-006 and is never written by NX15.

tweaks.name: Context menu configuration (classic / new)
tweaks.description: Read-only detection of the Windows 11 context-menu mode; the classic-menu mutation is defined but deliberately not shipped in engine v0.1.
tweaks.objective: Own the context-menu question honestly across builds without a non-reversible cosmetic hack.
tweaks.technicalExplanation: The community method for the classic menu creates HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32 with an empty default value (r4 Synergy family; the key was present read-only on build 26300.9974). Two hard blockers keep this entry at Defined in engine v0.1. (1) Build divergence: Microsoft documents the new streamlined context menu and its 'Show more options' bridge (File Explorer support page), but not a supported classic toggle; the CLSID method is the community-standard on 22H2/23H2, while 24H2+ is the reference-divergent build and NEXTRIX does not claim the method works there. Removing only the default value would leave the key behind, so a rollback could not be proven complete. Rather than ship a cosmetic hack that the journal cannot reverse, this file ships Get-NxContextMenuState (build classification plus CLSID/default-value state, read-only) and the apply action reports Defined/NotImplemented. No UCPD bypass, no third-party stub, no undocumented binary edits. Evidence E0 with build notes.

tweaks.name: Desktop icon configuration
tweaks.description: Ensures the desktop icon layer and two standard icons (This PC, Recycle Bin) are visible for the current user.
tweaks.objective: A journaled, per-user baseline for desktop icon visibility without hiding anything.
tweaks.technicalExplanation: Sets HideIcons=0 (DWord) under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced (global 'Show desktop icons'), and 0 for This PC ({20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D}) and Recycle Bin ({645FF040-5081-101B-9F08-00AA002F954E}) under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel (1 = hidden, 0 = shown). Read-only state on build 26300.9974 (2026-11-23): HideIcons=0; This PC hidden=1 in the reference profile; Recycle Bin value absent. Evidence E0 (catalogue E1 downgraded): Microsoft documents the desktop-icon toggles in the Desktop/Settings UI, but no Microsoft page verified this session documents these registry names; the GUIDs are shell class identifiers, not documented write targets. Windows 11 uses the NewStartPanel store; the ClassicStartMenu mirror is deliberately not written. Cosmetic only; no performance claim. Per-user; exact kinds and existence journaled; if the HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel key must be created, rollback removes the values it wrote and may leave an empty key (no configuration state, reported honestly).
tweaks.defaultState: Desktop icons visible (HideIcons=0); This PC/Recycle Bin visibility varies by profile.
tweaks.proposedState: HideIcons=0; This PC=0 and Recycle Bin=0 (shown) under HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel.

verify.procedure: Test-NxConfigurationState confirms HideIcons is DWord 0 and both GUID values are DWord 0; the desktop shows This PC and Recycle Bin (View > Show desktop icons remains checked).

rollback.procedure: Invoke-NxRollback restores each journaled original value/kind and deletes values that never existed. If the NewStartPanel key had to be created, the empty key may remain (no values, no configuration effect) - disclosed rather than hidden.

tweaks.name: Font smoothing configuration
tweaks.description: Ensures font smoothing is enabled with ClearType subpixel rendering for the current user.
tweaks.objective: Pin the per-user text rendering configuration to ClearType without claiming a performance outcome.
tweaks.technicalExplanation: Sets FontSmoothing='2' (String) and FontSmoothingType=2 (DWord) under HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop - the classic per-user text-rendering values (2 = smoothing enabled, type 2 = ClearType subpixel rendering). Both values and kinds were verified present read-only on build 26300.9974 (2026-11-23; both already 2). Evidence E0 (catalogue E1 downgraded): Microsoft documents ClearType as a Windows feature and the 'Smooth edges of screen fonts' visual-effect option, but no Microsoft page verified this session documents these value names/encodings, and the mechanism is community-known (r5 desktop value family). The action does not run the ClearType tuner (cttune.exe): per-display gamma/contrast tuning remains an owner action and is not silently changed. Cosmetic only: no performance claim, even though Windows groups the option under visual effects. Per-user; exact original kinds/values and existence journaled.
tweaks.defaultState: Font smoothing typically enabled with ClearType (2/2) depending on profile and display history.
tweaks.proposedState: FontSmoothing='2' (String) and FontSmoothingType=2 (DWord) for the current user.

verify.procedure: Test-NxConfigurationState confirms FontSmoothing is String '2' and FontSmoothingType is DWord 2; text renders with ClearType after sign-out or Explorer refresh.

rollback.procedure: Invoke-NxRollback restores each journaled original value/kind (or deletes values that never existed).

originalState.method: Capture-NxRegistryValue per value (keyExisted, existed, kind, value) journaled before mutation; per-display ClearType tuning is not touched.

sideEffects: Text uses ClearType subpixel smoothing; owners on unusual display configurations may prefer Standard (1) or smoothing off.
